contributions.summary: Model I/II/III enumerated structure with distinct techniques per task.
150 independent LSTM training runs for statistical prediction interval.
RFE feature selection reducing 6 to 3 dominant features.
Unequally weighted average Ew for difficulty comparison.
SVM-RBF classification consistent with XGBoost Ew predictions.
Human vs machine learning analysis (decision tree depth uncorrelated).

dependency_graph.label: XGBoost Ew defines difficulty labels for SVM classification.

assumptions.summary: Ignore extreme events (holidays, disasters) as rare.
2020 word frequency table representative of current usage.
Player results independently made without cheating.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Jan 30 outlier corrected to 25,569 from official Twitter.

models.summary: LSTM: 1 layer, 5 units, lookback=33, 150 runs, CI [20745.72, 22914.74].

verification.summary: Hard mode F-test: F=1.69 < 2.397, no correlation.
Sensitivity: Ew variation <1% across similar words.
Sum check: predicted sums within (98,102), variance 0.71.

results_trace.summary: No correlation between hard mode and word attributes (F=1.69).
EERIE classified as hard by SVM, consistent with Ew.
Decision tree depth uncorrelated with player performance.

writing_logic.summary: Model I/II/III enumeration mirrors task decomposition.
Literature review positions LSTM vs ARIMA with 84-87% error reduction.
Log-normalization justified by gamma distribution of scores.
Unequally weighted average designed to penalize harder tries more.
Ew thresholds derived from distribution shape (60% in 600-700).
Human vs ML comparison as unexpected finding (depth uncorrelated).
